ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a circle with P as the center, and points G, E, N, and M are all on the circumference; in the diagram there are line segments from P to points on the circumference forming a central angle, and the problem gives m∠GPM = 89. The vertex N of angle ∠GNM is on the circumference, and its two sides pass through G and M, so it is an inscribed angle intercepting the same arc GM. Because ∠GPM is a central angle and intercepts minor arc GM, m arc GM = 89°. The inscribed angle ∠GNM intercepts the same arc GM, and its measure is equal to half the measure of the intercepted arc, therefore m∠GNM = 89 ÷ 2 = 44.5°. The given m arc EN = 66 does not need to be used in this solution.

raw_record.question_text: In $\odot P$, $m\widehat{EN}=66$ and $m\angle GPM=89$. Find $m\angle GNM$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at P with G, E, N, and M on the circle. The segment PG and PM are radii, so ∠GPM is a central angle intercepting minor arc GM. From the text, m∠GPM = 89, hence m arc GM = 89. The angle ∠GNM has vertex N on the circle and its sides pass through G and M, so it is an inscribed angle intercepting the same arc GM. Therefore m∠GNM = 1/2 · 89 = 44.5. The given arc EN = 66 is not needed for this route.

因为 ∠GPM 是中心角，截小弧 GM，所以 m弧GM = 89°。圆周角 ∠GNM 截同一弧 GM，其度数等于所截弧度数的一半，因此 m∠GNM = 89 ÷ 2 = 44.5°。给出的 m弧EN = 66 在此解法中不需要使用。

method.method_draft: Read from the diagram that P lies on segment GN, so GN is a diameter and rays PG and PN are opposite rays. Since m∠GPM = 89, the adjacent central angle ∠MPN is supplementary to it: m∠MPN = 180 - 89 = 91. Because P is the center, PM and PN are radii, so triangle MPN is isosceles. Its base angles at M and N are equal, so m∠PNM = (180 - 91)/2 = 44.5. Since G, P, and N are collinear, ray NG is the same line as ray NP, making ∠GNM = ∠PNM = 44.5.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是以 P 为圆心的圆，点 G、E、N、M 在圆上。可以从图中看出点 P 位于线段 GN 上，因此 G、P、N 共线，GN 是直径；线段 PM 和 PN 都从圆心 P 连到圆上点。推理：因为射线 PG 和 PN 是相反射线，且 m∠GPM = 89°，所以相邻的中心角 m∠MPN = 180° - 89° = 91°。在三角形 MPN 中，PM = PN，故三角形 MPN 是等腰三角形，底角相等。于是 m∠PNM = (180° - 91°) / 2 = 44.5°。又因为 G、P、N 共线，从 N 看，射线 NG 与射线 NP 方向相同，所以 ∠GNM = ∠PNM = 44.5°。
